title: Backend-selectable launch execution: native tmax mutations with tmux-client terminal handoff
description:
Origin: user ask "do we use ~/src/tmax or are we shelling out? i'd love a build feature that switches between the two. tempted to make tmax the default." The parent audit (opencode://ses_e9a6011b0ffeBJ4GW5UhFqoHb5, commits dd4d7806/ea852864/9bcb6354) satisfied the LOOKUP half and closed tta-lookup-backends; this ticket holds the remainder so the board shows launch/backend execution still open. It does not claim the closed audit finished native launch.

What exists today (verified by reading current code, opencode://ses_e9a5990dfffeEYjKIU71KHzxZo):
- Lookup alone is backend-selectable. session/launcher/src/backend.rs: Native queries the tmax endpoint directly; Cli runs the same typed Sessions query through a tmux subprocess. app/cli/src/main.rs selects native/cli via Cargo features plus --backend / TTA_BACKEND (CLI > env > native-if-compiled), native default.
- ALL launch mutations and terminal handoff are planned as tmux argv. session/launcher/src/plan.rs builds tta_command Expressions over tmax operation::Invocations (new-session, attach-session, switch-client, set-option destroy-unattached); shell/command executes or renders them; app/cli/src/main.rs execs the tmux client (Handoff::Exec) or renders for eval (--print-shell / --exec-shell).
- Operation matrix (main.rs trace names): existing -> attach-session | switch-client; project -> new-session+attach | new-session-detached+switch-client; create -> scaffold+new-session(+attach | +switch); grouped -> new-grouped-session-detached+attach | +switch-client (detached create, set-option, then client move).

Closed-audit scope (tta-lookup-backends): verified feature selection and native default for session discovery only; fixed 3 scaffold tests that hardcoded the cli backend in native-only builds; documented the boundary in README.md#build-and-install (22/22 native-only, 20/20 cli-only+scaffold, 32/32 combined CLI+PTY). Closure = lookup verification, not native launch.

Remaining outcome: a deliberate backend selection for launch EXECUTION (mutations and handoff), preserving interactive terminal attachment through the real tmux client and unchanged --print-shell emission.

Verified tmax capabilities (~/src/tmax -> ~/src/tmux-interface-control; README and src read this session):
- Native mutation execution exists: endpoint::Tmux::run accepts impl IntoInvocation, implemented for raw operation::Invocation; plan.rs already assembles Invocations with argv boundaries preserved, and typed builders (e.g. NewSession) also run natively.
- Endpoints never spawn a client or start a server. An absent server surfaces as OperationError::ServerConnection; backend.rs already maps NotFound/ConnectionRefused to an empty inventory for lookup.
- Cold server: opt-in server-lifecycle OwnedServer launches `tmux -D` in the foreground at a FRESH explicit socket under a supervisor — private-server ownership, not shared-socket auto-start. Today's CLI plan relies on the exec'd tmux client auto-starting the server; a native create on an absent server fails instead. Cold-start posture is an open decision.
- No interactive terminal client exists in tmax: the process-launching root Tmux was removed, and the persistent Session's control-mode attach is a control client, not a terminal UI. attach-session handoff must remain an exec'd tmux client.

Open questions needing design resolution (design-first is acceptable; do not pre-decide):
- switch-client scope: the CLI command mutates the INVOKING client (tta detects its own context via socket.rs client_mode/$TMUX). A native control connection is a different client; how or whether the user's terminal client can be switched from a control connection is unresolved.
- Atomicity: the grouped flow currently creates + switches + sets destroy-unattached in ONE tmux invocation; splitting mutations (native) from handoff (exec) opens a partial-failure window needing explicit recovery semantics.
- Client-flag mapping: -f config, TMUX_TMPDIR, -L/-S live on the tmux client invocation in the plan; native execution maps the socket via Tmux::new().socket_path/socket_name (socket::Resolved already carries it), but startup-config semantics at server start need a decision.
- Cold-server posture (above) and whether native becomes the default for mutations as it already is for lookup (user leans tmax default).

Coherent possible scope, offered not decided: mirror the SessionLookup seam with a launch-execution seam in session/launcher — plan.rs stays pure assembly; an execution backend chooses native Tmux::run for mutations versus Expression exec, keeping print-shell rendering and terminal handoff on the Expression path.

Implementation homes: session/launcher/src/plan.rs (assembly), session/launcher/src/backend.rs (lookup seam to mirror), shell/command/src/lib.rs (Expression execute/shell), app/cli/src/main.rs (selection, handoff, print-shell), session/launcher/src/socket.rs (socket/client-mode context), README.md#build-and-install.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Design resolved and recorded: backend granularity (Cargo feature vs runtime flag), cold-server posture on absent server, switch-client scope from a control connection, partial-failure semantics for split mutate+handoff, and -f config mapping. 2) A launch-execution seam exists beside SessionLookup with mutation operations runnable natively (Tmux::run over the Invocations plan.rs already builds) and via the CLI path, selected per the decided granularity. 3) Interactive attach/switch terminal handoff still execs the real tmux client; --print-shell/--exec-shell output is unchanged for both selections. 4) Feature-matrix verification on tmux 3.7c: existing/project/create/grouped flows on each backend plus mixed selection, cold-server behavior matching the decided posture, and PTY acceptance coverage mirroring the closed audit's configurations.
notes: Context ticket written by opencode://ses_e9a5990dfffeEYjKIU71KHzxZo (G subagent) on direction from parent audit opencode://ses_e9a6011b0ffeBJ4GW5UhFqoHb5, which closed tta-lookup-backends as lookup-only. Capability claims verified against ~/src/tmux-interface-control README.md, src/endpoint/mod.rs (run/query signatures), src/server/mod.rs (OwnedServer), src/lib.rs docs, and tta's current backend.rs/plan.rs/main.rs/shell-command. No implementation done here; keep open until the design questions are resolved and an execution seam lands.

title: Verify feature-selectable tmax and tmux CLI lookup with native default
description: Confirm the existing native/cli Cargo feature selection, default native tmax lookup, and runtime backend override. Explain the boundary: session inventory is backend-selectable; launch actions execute the tmux client. ~/src/tmax resolves to the dependency checkout ../tmux-interface-control. Current homes: app/cli/Cargo.toml, session/launcher/src/backend.rs, README.md#build-and-install. Requested audit and ticket record: opencode://ses_e9a6011b0ffeBJ4GW5UhFqoHb5.
acceptance_criteria: Verify native-only, CLI-only and combined builds using existing backend coverage; document tmux execution boundary and preserve the audit in version control.
notes:
Completed audit in opencode://ses_e9a6011b0ffeBJ4GW5UhFqoHb5; commit ea852864. Existing native feature is the default; cli is opt-in, and both permit --backend selection (CLI > TTA_BACKEND > native if compiled). ~/src/tmax and ../tmux-interface-control resolve to the same checkout. Session discovery uses direct tmax queries or tmux subprocesses; all launch actions still execute tmux. README.md#build-and-install now states that boundary explicitly. Fixed three scaffold tests that incorrectly forced the unavailable cli backend in default builds. Verified existing CLI and real PTY acceptance tests: native-only default 22/22; CLI-only with scaffold features retained 20/20; combined 32/32. cargo fmt -p tta --check and rkt check --okf README.md passed. This confirms lookup selection, not a fully native launch/terminal implementation.
Closure scope clarification (opencode://ses_e9a5990dfffeEYjKIU71KHzxZo): this ticket verified feature-selectable LOOKUP only — native-default discovery, backend override, scaffold test fixes, and the README boundary statement. The broader launch/backend execution work (native tmax mutations, cold-server posture, switch-client scope, handoff split) remains open and is now tracked in tta-launch-backends.
close_reason: Verified existing native-default and optional CLI lookup across three feature configurations; corrected native-only scaffold test regressions and documented the tmux execution boundary. Commit ea852864; 74 focused CLI/PTY checks passed across configurations, plus formatting and document verification.

title: Adapt rekon generators to current remotes (tangled) and jj bookmark tracking; fix pnpm in both
notes: Commissioned in session opencode://ses_e9b671d21ffeJXXTDi6GZnjm60 after inspecting live repos: rekon tracks main on four remotes (origin github, tngl tangled.org via ssh alias 'Host tangled.org tangled tngl', voodoo archive, dl); @voodoo shows 'not created yet', proving jj bookmark track works before first push and without network. jj 0.45: the command is 'jj bookmark track'; bookmarks must be created before 'jj commit' to land on the init commit. Changes: rekon-native remotes become a name->template map (origin/tngl/voodoo defaults, '' disables, extra keys add remotes); git tracking config stays origin-only; generator adds 'jj bookmark create BRANCH' and 'jj bookmark track BRANCH@<each remote>'; ~/.local/bin/rekon pnpm i -q -> pnpm install --silent.
close_reason: Implemented and verified in session opencode://ses_e9b671d21ffeJXXTDi6GZnjm60. rekon-native remotes are now a merged map (origin github, tngl tangled.org, voodoo archive; '' disables, extra keys add); jj bookmark create before the init commit plus jj bookmark track per remote, verified locally network-free against a bare origin by tests/live.rs running the real generated sequence (colocated repo, main on the init commit, tracked not-yet-created remotes, exported git branch). The ~/.local/bin/rekon script's pnpm i -q was fixed to pnpm install --silent in place. title: Native parameterized rekon generator: Rust reimplementation adapter with registry options
notes:
Commissioned in session opencode://ses_e9b671d21ffeJXXTDi6GZnjm60. User direction: parameterize and improve over the rekon script, do not reproduce it exactly ('its kind of tar').

Scope:
- Per-entry registry options: [scaffold.generators.NAME.options] table passed to the adapter; adapters validate their own options (serde, deny unknown fields) with errors naming the entry. Wrap adapter rekon takes no options.
- scaffold/rekon-native crate, feature scaffold-rekon-native: honors the configured root (not hardcoded ~/src); git init -b BRANCH (default main) instead of init + checkout; origin/voodoo remote templates with {name} substitution (both optional); starter files list (default README.md + {name}.ts); package.json authored directly in Rust (no npm init/jq/unexpand) with author (param > AUTHOR env > git config user.name > omit), license (param > LICENSE env > MIT), module {name}.js, type module; optional pnpm install; jj git init + jj commit. Drop the script's cat/echo noise.
- tta_command gains a file-write expression node (direct fs::write; shell rendering via printf '%s' with redirection) so literal file contents stay values, never shell source.
close_reason: Implemented and verified in session opencode://ses_e9b671d21ffeJXXTDi6GZnjm60: tta_command file-write expressions; scaffold/rekon-native crate (parameterized branch/remotes/starter-files/author/license/package-json/install, git init -b, pnpm install --silent); registry options tables through the shared launcher scaffold module (rekon wrap rejects options). Checks: nextest 113/113 all-features and 82/82 cli-only, clippy -D warnings clean, fmt clean, doctests pass, rkt check --okf clean. Commits: 'Add file-write expressions to the command model', 'Add the parameterized rekon-native generator adapter crate', 'Wire rekon-native into the scaffold registry with per-entry options', 'Document the rekon-native adapter and its registry options'.

title: Skeleton-generation mode: scaffold missing projects before creating the session
notes:
Commissioned and v1 implemented in session opencode://ses_e9b671d21ffeJXXTDi6GZnjm60 (lucky-moon).

Decisions recorded 2026-10-22:
- Trigger: unambiguous miss only (no session, no immediate directory under root, no candidates). Ambiguity still stops; existing sessions still win.
- Adapter crates: each scaffolding system is its own crate under scaffold/ behind app/cli cargo features. v1: scaffold/rekon wraps the external rekon script (program rekon, one arg: project name, PATH lookup). Native Rust port of the script is a deliberate later step ('not so crappy'); caveat: the script hardcodes ~/src so a non-default TTA_ROOT diverges until the port.
- Registry: named registry in a TOML config file (~/.config/tta/config.toml, TTA_CONFIG overrides). Entries [scaffold.generators.NAME] with adapter = compiled adapter name; [scaffold] default picks the miss generator. Empty/absent registry keeps today's miss error.
- Posture: default create-on-miss via default feature scaffold-by-default; removing the feature flips the default to opt-in. Per-invocation: --scaffold[=NAME] / --scaffold=false and TTA_SCAFFOLD env, CLI > env > compiled default.
- Safety: fragment must be a safe single path component; session-name validation and collision checks run before the generator executes; refuse if root/NAME already exists; plan is generator && cd -P && tmux new-session, short-circuiting.
- Design doc: design/scaffold/proposal0.glm53max.md
v1 implemented and verified in session opencode://ses_e9b671d21ffeJXXTDi6GZnjm60, commits 'Add scaffold adapter crate and create-mode resolution and planning', 'Add TOML scaffold registry, config loading, and CLI scaffold mode', 'Document scaffold mode and record the design decisions'. Checks: fmt/clippy -D warnings clean; nextest 91/91 all-features and 69/69 no-default-features+cli; doctests pass; rkt check --okf clean on README and proposal. Remaining: native rekon port, more adapters (see tta-start-it-up-ref), per-adapter config, runtime-driver scaffold scenario.
rekon-native adapter with per-entry registry options added per user direction ('parameterize/improve over it, not reproduce exactly'); see closed tta-scaffold-rekon-native for verification. Note: scaffold registry moved into session/launcher by a parallel session (commits 'Share scaffold registry and resolution between CLI and library' and 'Complete the shared scaffold registry and satellite name selection'); this session committed the latter's uncommitted completion unchanged before building on it.

title: Complete live project and session names with wildcard matching in Zim/Zsh
description: Provide a Zim-compatible Zsh completion module for tta, with wildcard and substring Tab matching of immediate project directories and live tmux sessions. Respect CLI/environment root and endpoint configuration; completion must not create or attach sessions. Document installation and verify in real Zsh completion contexts.
notes:
Implementation in opencode://ses_e9b668237ffe74i4Il8nao5Vqr: adding read-only Rust candidate inventory and Zim-compatible Zsh wildcard/substring completion with isolated verification.
Implemented in 14647704 and b50e2bba. Current guide: README.md#zim--zsh-completion; module: shell/zsh/functions/_tta; verification: app/cli/tests/completion.rs and shell/zsh/tests/completion.zsh. Read-only hidden candidate mode shares Rust root/environment/backend logic and project enumeration; completion supports substring/wildcard matching, escaped names, option values and endpoint overrides. Verified 66/66 workspace all-feature tests, 53/53 CLI-only workspace tests, and latest completion tests in all-feature, native-only and CLI-only builds; clippy --no-deps -D warnings, formatting, Zsh syntax and Rekon OKF/link checks passed. Existing tmax dependency warnings remain. Not installed/enabled in personal shell; documented binary installation and Zim zmodule configuration. Session: opencode://ses_e9b668237ffe74i4Il8nao5Vqr.
Compfuzor follow-through: commit c65ce14d in /home/rektide/src/compfuzor adds ZIM_MODULES to tta.src.pb, using a shell-quoted REPO_DIR/shell/zsh external module at tools phase 55 (before compinit), and RUST_PKG=tta to select only the launcher. tests/integration/tta_zim.test.py renders the real playbook in isolated scratch, checks quoted checkout paths, the generated user importer, package selection and no checkout/bin execution. Ansible syntax check, integration render, and Zim fragment filter suite passed. No live deployment or user-shell mutation. Session: opencode://ses_e9b668237ffe74i4Il8nao5Vqr.
Live user deployment completed at explicit operator request. Generated Compfuzor donor under /home/rektide/.local/opt/tta with USERMODE and existing-source override; repo symlink points to /home/rektide/src/tta. The live source build failed on concurrent unfinished Selection::Create scaffolding work, so installed verified revision b50e2bba from isolated archive /tmp/opencode/tta-user-install.QKppOi/repo through generated install-rust-user.sh (RUST_PKG=tta). Only executable tta replaced at /home/rektide/.cargo/bin/tta. Ran generated install-zim-user.sh: imported ~/.config/zsh/zimrc.d/55-tta.conf and rebuilt user Zim init/compinit cache. Fresh interactive shell resolves tta to ~/.cargo/bin/tta and _comps[tta]=_tta; installed inventory lists compfuzor. Real user Zsh PTY with existing fzf-completion binding verified wildcard Tab `tta --root /home/rektide/src *compfu*` -> compfuzor. No global keybinding changes or tmux session launches. Session: opencode://ses_e9b668237ffe74i4Il8nao5Vqr.
close_reason: Implemented and verified Zim-compatible live project/session wildcard completion, isolated read-only inventories and installation guide. All-feature and CLI-only suites plus native-only completion checks pass; shell activation remains an explicit user setup step.
